name: Apple Cider Baked Chicken and Cabbage

fit.note: Published 418 cal / 20g carb clears both bands; ruling on published numbers, source-flagged low-cal-floor drift risk is not disqualifying.

dupe_check.catalog: No catalog dupe. Closest is 'Chicken Normandy (Apple Cider Braised Chicken)' (chicken-normandy-apple-cider) which shares chicken+apple-cider but is a creamy French braise (cream/mushroom, no cabbage) versus this rustic Dijon oven bake with red cabbage and apple wedges - different dinner (method braise-vs-bake, sauce creamy-vs-Dijon-cider-vinegar, cabbage present only here). 'Dak Galbi' shares chicken+cabbage but is a Korean gochujang skillet - unrelated flavor family.
dupe_check.accepted_slugs: No collision with this run's accepted bakes (chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake, jalapeno-popper-chicken-casserole are cheese/cauliflower bakes, not cider/cabbage).

cross_protein_collision_notes: Catalog 'Sausage, Cabbage and Apple Skillet' (sausage-cabbage-apple-skillet) is the same cabbage+apple flavor combo in a different protein/method - decider should confirm no pool candidate re-runs that combo as sausage/pork.

Braised-or-baked meat + cabbage + apple is a Central/European rustic template; a pork, sausage, or turkey 'cabbage and apple' candidate in another selector's pool would be structurally the same plate - flag for cross-protein merge.
evidence_one_line: KEEP - no catalog dupe; nearest is Chicken Normandy (creamy cider braise, no cabbage) which is a distinct dinner from this Dijon apple-cider oven bake of chicken with red cabbage and apple.
